Hi Lina — quick update and proposal. Thanks for waiting. Summary of findings:

- Root cause: our post-deploy telemetry shows a token-refresh race in the legacy metering adapter on Aug 19 02:12–02:20 UTC that resulted in duplicated meter records for ~38k tokens for Acme's org. This aligns with the spike you saw; the requests themselves originated from an IP tied to your reported CIDR but were retried by our adapter.
- Corrective action taken: we deactivated the legacy adapter for your tenant on Aug 20 and applied a fix cluster-wide on Sep 1.
- VAT: your account is configured with "Acme Tech EUR GmbH" and VAT ID DE123456789. VAT should not have been charged — this was an invoice-generation bug.

Proposed remedy:
1) Issue a credit of $1,120.75 to offset the duplicated token charges (will appear on next invoice).
2) Void and reissue the August invoice without VAT (new PDF attached).
3) Provide a one-time goodwill credit of $250 to cover AP overhead and expedite payment.

If you accept, we'll reissue the invoice and share the corrected invoice number and a payment link for the revised amount. We can also provide the raw metering lines for your internal auditors (CSV).

Attachment: invoice_2026-08_acme_reissued.pdf (PDF, 118KB)

Please let me know if that solution works and whether you'd prefer the credit applied immediately or shown on the next billing cycle. Apologies again for the inconvenience — we know AP holds and this should unblock payment quickly.
